queries.name: cmb-instrumentation
queries.query: cat:astro-ph.IM AND (all:CMB OR all:"cosmic microwave background")

queries.name: early-universe
queries.query: (cat:hep-ph OR cat:hep-th OR cat:gr-qc) AND (all:inflation OR all:"early universe" OR all:axion OR all:neutrino OR all:"primordial black hole")

backfill_queries.name: cmb-archive
backfill_queries.query: (cat:astro-ph.CO OR cat:astro-ph.IM) AND (all:CMB OR all:"cosmic microwave background" OR all:"B-mode" OR all:reionization OR all:"Sunyaev-Zeldovich" OR all:"component separation")

backfill_queries.name: early-universe-archive
backfill_queries.query: (cat:astro-ph.CO OR cat:hep-ph OR cat:hep-th OR cat:gr-qc) AND (all:inflation OR all:"primordial power spectrum" OR all:"early universe" OR all:neutrino OR all:axion OR all:"primordial black hole")

backfill_queries.name: lensing-survey-archive
backfill_queries.query: cat:astro-ph.CO AND (all:lensing OR all:"large-scale structure" OR all:DESI OR all:Euclid OR all:"dark energy" OR all:"Hubble tension")

backfill_queries.name: discovery-archive
backfill_queries.query: (cat:astro-ph.GA OR cat:astro-ph.HE OR cat:gr-qc) AND (all:"first detection" OR all:discovery OR all:anomaly OR all:"new constraint" OR all:"gravitational wave" OR all:"black hole" OR all:JWST)
